description: Create a Search Results page and wire up HeroSearch to navigate there. When a user types a keyword (city name like 'bangalore', area like 'jayanagar', or any space name) and presses Enter or clicks Search, they should be taken to /search?q=<keyword> which displays all matching spaces from Supabase as listing cards.
steps: 1. Create a new page component at src/pages/SearchResults.jsx. This page reads the `q` query parameter from the URL, uses useSupabaseSpaces() from src/context/SpacesContext.jsx to get all spaces, and filters them by matching the keyword against address_city, address_area, space_name, and listing_address fields (case-insensitive includes). Display matching spaces as listing cards following the card rendering pattern from src/components/virtual-office/ExploreSpaces.jsx (the card JSX around line 500-660 with image, badge, rating, name, city, tags, price, and 'Enquire' button). Each card links to the space detail page via spaceUrl(citySlug, areaSlug). Use framer-motion for card animations, SmartImage for images, and Tailwind classes consistent with the rest of the site. Include a heading showing the search keyword and result count. If no results, show a friendly 'No spaces found' message with a suggestion to try different keywords. Import slugifySpace and spaceUrl from src/data/spaces.js.
2. Add a /search route to src/App.jsx. Lazy-load the SearchResults page (same pattern as other pages). Place the route before the catch-all NotFound route.

3. Modify the handleSearch function in src/components/home/HeroSearch.jsx. When the service is 'virtual-office' and the user submits (Enter key or Search button click): instead of navigating to a city page or space detail page, ALWAYS navigate to /search?q=<location> with the raw typed keyword. Remove the city/state/space resolution logic from handleSearch for virtual-office service. Keep the existing suggestion dropdown click behavior (selectSuggestion) - clicking a suggestion in the dropdown can still navigate directly to city/space pages as it does now. For other service types (coworking, meeting-room, ca-services), keep existing behavior.

4. Also update the popular city chips in HeroSearch.jsx: when a popular city chip is clicked AND then the user hits Search, it should go to /search?q=<city>. Currently clicking a chip just sets the location input. That behavior is fine - the user will then click Search and the new handleSearch logic will take them to the search results page.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /search?q=bangalore shows all spaces with 'bangalore' or 'bengaluru' in their city/area/name fields as listing cards
Navigating to /search?q=jayanagar shows all spaces matching 'jayanagar' in area/name/address
Typing 'bangalore' in HeroSearch and pressing Enter navigates to /search?q=bangalore
Clicking Search button in HeroSearch with 'jayanagar' typed navigates to /search?q=jayanagar
Clicking a suggestion in the dropdown still navigates directly to the city/space page (existing behavior preserved)
The search results page displays space cards with image, name, city, rating, price, tags, and link to detail page
Empty search results show a friendly message
The page is lazy-loaded and follows existing code patterns
verification: Run: node -e "require('acorn').parse(require('fs').readFileSync('src/pages/SearchResults.jsx','utf8'),{ecmaVersion:2022,sourceType:'module',ecmaFeatures:{jsx:true}})" or equivalent AST check to confirm the file is syntactically valid JSX
Grep src/App.jsx for the /search route to confirm it was added
Grep src/components/home/HeroSearch.jsx for '/search?q=' to confirm navigation was updated
